CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feed_delete(p_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare v_actor uuid:=zoi.community_actor();begin delete from zoi.feed_posts where id=p_id and profile_id=v_actor;return found;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.community_actor()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare actor uuid;begin if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'community_sign_in_required' using errcode='42501';end if;perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('community_auth:'||auth.uid()::text,0));actor:=zoi.ensure_profile();return actor;end $function$
